<USER_REQUEST>
FIX REAL SATELLITE IMAGE VIEWING, ALL CHANGE-DETECTION BUTTONS, AND SATELLITE CATALOG DATA LINKAGE

You are working on the existing TN Forest Monitoring System.

There are TWO related functional problems that must be fixed completely:

PROBLEM 1:
The Change Detection detail page contains buttons that appear clickable but do not work.

PROBLEM 2:
REAL satellite observations that were successfully acquired and used for change detection are NOT appearing in the Satellite Catalog for the corresponding zone.

These must be fixed at the underlying data/API/raster architecture level.

DO NOT create mock data.
DO NOT hardcode the validation scene IDs.
DO NOT create duplicate satellite records.
DO NOT replace real imagery with placeholders.
DO NOT modify the scientific change-detection algorithms.

============================================================
IMPORTANT EXISTING VALIDATION RECORD
============================================================

Zone:

VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2

Zone ObjectId:

6ac5a9d496837067de289f3b

Existing Change Detection:

CHG-1791379089579-2827

The Change Detection record currently references REAL Sentinel-2 observations.

BASELINE:

Date:
09 Jan 2020

Scene:
COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED/20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM

CURRENT:

Date:
22 Jan 2026

Scene:
COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED/20260122T051019_20260122T052254_T43PHM

The Change Detection UI already proves that REAL satellite raster processing occurred:

- REAL SATELLITE RASTER
- EPSG:32643
- 10m resolution
- GEE telemetry
- Sentinel-2 baseline/current observations
- Change detection result

Therefore the problem is NOT to acquire new imagery.

The problem is correctly connecting the existing authoritative records to:

1. Satellite Catalog
2. Raster/image viewer
3. Change Detection buttons
4. Before/After viewer
5. GIS viewer
6. Side-by-side comparison
7. Curtain slider

============================================================
RULE 1 — DO NOT MODIFY SCIENTIFIC PROCESSING
============================================================

Do NOT modify:

- NDVI calculation
- ΔNDVI calculation
- change threshold
- optical compatibility
- HLS algorithm
- SAR algorithm
- baseline activation rules
- monitoring scheduler scientific behavior
- GEE acquisition logic
- pixel change detection
- affected-area calculation
- alert severity calculation

Only fix the broken data linkage, API contracts, raster serving,
frontend interaction, and catalog integration.

If an existing data-contract problem is discovered, fix the contract
without changing the scientific calculation.

============================================================
PHASE 1 — TRACE THE COMPLETE EXISTING DATA FLOW
============================================================

Before changing code, inspect the existing implementation.

Trace:

GEE discovery
→ SatelliteMetadata
→ acquisition/export
→ raster storage
→ raster metadata
→ zone relationship
→ baseline/current reference
→ ChangeDetection
→ Satellite Catalog
→ raster viewer

Do not guess where the problem is.

Inspect the actual:

- SatelliteMetadata model
- SatelliteMetadata schema
- SatelliteMetadata repository
- SatelliteMetadata service
- SatelliteMetadata controller
- Satellite Catalog routes
- Satellite Catalog frontend service
- Satellite Catalog page
- acquisition/export records
- raster storage implementation
- raster metadata
- ChangeDetection model
- baseline/current observation references
- ChangeDetection service
- image viewer service
- image/raster controller
- GIS viewer
- comparison viewer
- Side-by-Side viewer
- Curtain Slider implementation
- frontend routes
- frontend API calls
- authentication/RBAC middleware

Use the actual existing architecture.

Do not create parallel implementations unnecessarily.

============================================================
PHASE 2 — FIX SATELLITE CATALOG ZONE LINKAGE
============================================================

This is a PRIMARY bug.

The Satellite Catalog must display the SAME REAL observations that were
actually acquired and processed for the selected zone.

Required data flow:

REAL GEE OBSERVATION
        ↓
SatelliteMetadata persistence
        ↓
Correct zone association
        ↓
Acquisition/export
        ↓
Actual raster artifact
        ↓
Satellite Catalog API
        ↓
Selected Zone Catalog UI

For:

VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2

verify that the existing persisted observations:

20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM

and

20260122T051019_20260122T052254_T43PHM

are correctly associated with:

Zone ObjectId:
6ac5a9d496837067de289f3b

Do NOT blindly assume the field name.

Inspect the real schema.

Determine whether the relationship uses:

- zoneId
- zoneCode
- markedAreaId
- geometry
- another identifier

and use the authoritative existing relationship.

============================================================
PHASE 3 — FIND WHY THE CATALOG DOES NOT SHOW THEM
============================================================

Trace the real browser request:

Satellite Catalog
→ selected zone
→ frontend service
→ HTTP request
→ backend route
→ controller
→ service
→ repository
→ database query
→ SatelliteMetadata records
→ response
→ frontend state
→ rendered catalog

Check all of the following:

- wrong zone ID
- wrong zone code
- ObjectId/string mismatch
- missing zone association
- wrong MongoDB query
- wrong repository
- wrong collection
- acquisition status filter
- processing status filter
- date filter
- cloud filter
- sensor filter
- pagination
- response property mismatch
- frontend state mismatch
- stale cached data
- incorrect route prefix
- incorrect query parameter
- hidden/filtered records
- catalog using a different source from acquisition

Identify the EXACT root cause.

Fix the underlying cause.

============================================================
PHASE 4 — FUTURE ACQUISITIONS MUST WORK AUTOMATICALLY
============================================================

Do NOT fix this only for:

VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2

and do NOT hardcode:

20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM

or:

20260122T051019_20260122T051951_T43PHM

The real fix must ensure:

Zone A
→ GEE acquisition
→ SatelliteMetadata
→ correct Zone A association
→ Satellite Catalog Zone A

and:

Zone B
→ GEE acquisition
→ SatelliteMetadata
→ correct Zone B association
→ Satellite Catalog Zone B

No manual database repair should be required for future acquisitions.

If existing validation records are missing only a relationship, repair the
relationship without duplicating the records.

============================================================
PHASE 5 — SATELLITE CATALOG UI
============================================================

When the operator opens:

Satellite Catalog
→ VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2

the real acquired observations must appear.

Display appropriate real metadata:

- acquisition date/time
- satellite/platform
- source/collection
- scene/image ID
- cloud percentage
- processing level
- acquisition status
- raster availability
- CRS
- resolution

At minimum, the validation catalog must show:

09 Jan 2020
Sentinel-2
20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM

22 Jan 2026
Sentinel-2
20260122T051019_20260122T052254_T43PHM

Do not create frontend-only records.

Do not use mock data.

============================================================
PHASE 6 — STRICT ZONE DATA ISOLATION
============================================================

When the operator selects a zone in Satellite Catalog:

SHOW ONLY observations belonging to that zone.

Do NOT display:

- another zone's imagery
- global satellite results
- unrelated baselines
- unrelated change detections
- alerts
- monitoring jobs
- enforcement data

The Satellite Catalog is an Earth Observation workspace.

============================================================
PHASE 7 — FIX VIEW BASELINE IMAGE
============================================================

The "View Baseline Image" button must work.

Required flow:

ChangeDetection
→ baseline observation ID
→ SatelliteMetadata/acquisition
→ authoritative raster artifact
→ secure backend raster endpoint
→ frontend viewer

The viewer must display the ACTUAL acquired baseline raster.

For the validation record it must resolve to:

2020-01-09
Sentinel-2
20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM

Do NOT hardcode this scene.

The same mechanism must work for all future ChangeDetection records.

============================================================
PHASE 8 — FIX VIEW CURRENT IMAGE
============================================================

The "View Current Image" button must work.

Required flow:

ChangeDetection
→ current observation ID
→ SatelliteMetadata/acquisition
→ authoritative raster artifact
→ secure backend raster endpoint
→ frontend viewer

For the validation record it must resolve to:

2026-01-22
Sentinel-2
20260122T051019_20260122T052254_T43PHM

Do NOT hardcode this scene.

============================================================
PHASE 9 — FIX GIS MAP BUTTON
============================================================

The "GIS Map" button must actually open the existing GIS/map workspace.

It must use the selected ChangeDetection record.

Display/use the existing authoritative:

- zone geometry
- change geometry/mask where available
- baseline/current spatial context
- raster imagery where supported

Reuse the existing GIS implementation.

Do not create fake map data.

Verify:

GIS Map click
→ correct ChangeDetection ID
→ correct zone
→ correct spatial data
→ map opens
→ layers render.

============================================================
PHASE 10 — FIX BEFORE / AFTER
============================================================

The "Before / After" control must actually open the comparison viewer.

BEFORE:
authoritative baseline raster

AFTER:
authoritative current raster

Both must come from the ChangeDetection record.

Do NOT use:

- mock images
- generic basemaps as the satellite imagery
- unrelated satellite imagery
- placeholders
- duplicated imagery

============================================================
PHASE 11 — FIX SIDE-BY-SIDE DUAL VIEW
============================================================

The "Side-by-Side Dual View" button must work.

Display:

LEFT:
BASELINE / BEFORE

RIGHT:
CURRENT / AFTER

Both must be real acquired satellite rasters.

Requirements:

- correct images
- correct dates
- correct labels
- same geographic context
- spatial alignment
- synchronized extent/zoom where applicable

Do not display the same image twice.

============================================================
PHASE 12 — FIX CURTAIN SLIDER
============================================================

The "Curtain Slider" button must work.

It must provide a real interactive comparison:

BASELINE raster
versus
CURRENT raster

Moving the slider must reveal/hide the corresponding actual image.

Requirements:

- smooth interaction
- actual baseline raster
- actual current raster
- spatial alignment
- correct geographic extent
- correct labels

Do not implement a visual-only slider without real image layers.

============================================================
PHASE 13 — FIX ALL OTHER VISIBLE BUTTONS
============================================================

Do NOT assume only the above buttons are broken.

Inspect the entire Change Detection detail page.

Find EVERY visible interactive control:

- GIS Map
- Before / After
- View Baseline Image
- View Current Image
- Side-by-Side Dual View
- Curtain Slider
- tabs
- dropdowns
- filters
- refresh buttons
- navigation buttons
- map controls
- detail links
- modal triggers
- selectors
- pagination
- any additional visible action

EVERY visible clickable control must:

A. work correctly,

OR

B. be intentionally removed/disabled with an explicit appropriate state.

There must be NO dead buttons.

For every control trace:

USER CLICK
→ handler
→ API/service
→ backend route
→ controller
→ service
→ repository/data
→ response
→ frontend state
→ visible result

============================================================
PHASE 14 — IMAGE/RASTER SERVING
============================================================

Determine the ACTUAL stored raster format.

Do not assume PNG/JPEG.

If the scientific artifact is GeoTIFF:

- preserve the original GeoTIFF unchanged
- use the existing raster rendering mechanism where possible
- provide a browser-compatible visualization
- maintain correct geographic extent
- maintain CRS handling
- never replace the scientific raster with a screenshot

The frontend must NOT construct filesystem paths.

The backend must resolve the raster from an authorized observation/acquisition
record.

============================================================
PHASE 15 — SECURITY
============================================================

Raster/image endpoints must NOT expose arbitrary filesystem access.

Prevent:

- ../ path traversal
- arbitrary filesystem paths
- arbitrary URL fetching
- unrelated file access

Use authenticated internal record/observation IDs.

Preserve existing authentication and RBAC.

============================================================
PHASE 16 — LOADING AND ERROR STATES
============================================================

Every asynchronous action must have:

IDLE
LOADING
SUCCESS
ERROR

For example:

View Current Image
→ Loading...
→ Real image displayed

or:

View Current Image
→ Unable to load current satellite raster
→ meaningful error
→ Retry

Never leave a button apparently frozen.

Prevent duplicate requests while loading where appropriate.

============================================================
PHASE 17 — BROWSER NETWORK VERIFICATION
============================================================

Use the actual running application.

Open browser DevTools.

For every broken control inspect:

- HTTP method
- URL
- parameters
- request body
- authentication
- status code
- response body
- content type
- frontend parsing
- rendering

Fix actual:

404
401
403
422
500
CORS
wrong route
wrong parameter
wrong response field
undefined ID
null raster reference
broken image response

Do not suppress errors.

============================================================
PHASE 18 — REAL VALIDATION WORKFLOW
============================================================

Use:

ZONE:
VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2

CHANGE:
CHG-1791379089579-2827

Perform exactly:

1. Open Monitoring Areas.
2. Select VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2.
3. Open Satellite Catalog.
4. Verify real acquired observations appear.
5. Refresh.
6. Verify they remain visible.
7. Open each observation.
8. Verify its real raster/image works.
9. Open Change Detection.
10. Open CHG-1791379089579-2827.
11. Click GIS Map.
12. Click Before / After.
13. Click View Baseline Image.
14. Click View Current Image.
15. Click Side-by-Side Dual View.
16. Click Curtain Slider.
17. Move the curtain slider.
18. Navigate away.
19. Return to the change record.
20. Repeat the image actions.
21. Verify all controls still work.

============================================================
PHASE 19 — CATALOG ZONE ISOLATION TEST
============================================================

Test at least two zones if available.

Zone A:
VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2

Verify its observations appear.

Open another zone.

Verify the Sirumalai observations do NOT appear there.

Return to Sirumalai.

Verify the observations appear again.

This proves the catalog is actually zone-scoped rather than displaying a
global/static list.

============================================================
PHASE 20 — NO FAKE DATA / NO HARDcoding
============================================================

Absolutely do NOT:

- create fake SatelliteMetadata
- create mock observations
- hardcode scene IDs
- hardcode image URLs
- hardcode raster paths
- insert frontend-only satellite records
- generate replacement imagery
- bypass the database
- bypass GEE acquisition records
- duplicate existing observations
- use generic imagery as a replacement
- silently hide failed requests

Fix the actual underlying data relationship and serving mechanism.

============================================================
PHASE 21 — AUTOMATED TESTS
============================================================

Add/fix tests for:

1. Satellite Catalog returns observations for selected zone.
2. Correct zone filtering.
3. Baseline observation resolves.
4. Current observation resolves.
5. Baseline raster resolves.
6. Current raster resolves.
7. GIS Map receives correct ChangeDetection ID.
8. Before/After receives correct two observations.
9. Side-by-side receives correct two rasters.
10. Curtain Slider receives correct two rasters.
11. Missing raster returns controlled error.
12. Unauthorized raster access is rejected.
13. Path traversal is rejected.
14. No duplicate SatelliteMetadata records.
15. Future acquisitions persist zone association.
16. Future acquisitions become visible in Satellite Catalog.

Existing scientific tests MUST remain passing.

============================================================
PHASE 22 — BUILD AND REGRESSION
============================================================

Run:

- all server tests
- all client tests
- relevant integration tests
- scientific validation tests
- server typecheck
- client typecheck
- client build

Do not modify scientific tests simply to make them pass.

============================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
============================================================

SATELLITE CATALOG:

[ ] Real acquired observations appear for VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2
[ ] Baseline observation appears
[ ] Current observation appears
[ ] Correct scene IDs displayed
[ ] Correct acquisition dates displayed
[ ] Correct cloud/source metadata displayed
[ ] Correct zone association
[ ] No duplicate records
[ ] No mock records
[ ] Zone isolation works
[ ] Refresh preserves results
[ ] Future acquisitions automatically appear

CHANGE DETECTION:

[ ] GIS Map works
[ ] Before / After works
[ ] View Baseline Image works
[ ] View Current Image works
[ ] Side-by-Side Dual View works
[ ] Curtain Slider works
[ ] Every other visible button/control works
[ ] No dead buttons
[ ] No broken image
[ ] No blank viewer
[ ] Correct real raster displayed
[ ] Correct geographic alignment
[ ] Loading states work
[ ] Error states work

TECHNICAL:

[ ] No 404 API errors
[ ] No 401/403 errors for authorized user
[ ] No 500 errors
[ ] No CORS errors
[ ] No undefined IDs
[ ] No null raster references
[ ] No filesystem path exposure
[ ] No path traversal vulnerability
[ ] Authentication/RBAC preserved
[ ] Scientific algorithms unchanged
[ ] Existing production data preserved

VERIFICATION:

Create a final table:

| Feature | Tested | API | Result | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Satellite Catalog | YES | ... | Real observations visible | PASS |
| Baseline Image | YES | ... | Real raster visible | PASS |
| Current Image | YES | ... | Real raster visible | PASS |
| GIS Map | YES | ... | Map rendered | PASS |
| Before / After | YES | ... | Both images rendered | PASS |
| Side-by-Side | YES | ... | Both images rendered | PASS |
| Curtain Slider | YES | ... | Interactive comparison | PASS |

Add every additional control discovered.

FINAL REPORT MUST STATE:

1. Root cause of Satellite Catalog failure.
2. Root cause of each broken button.
3. Files changed.
4. APIs/endpoints changed.
5. Database relationships involved.
6. Raster serving mechanism.
7. Browser verification results.
8. Network/API verification results.
9. Console error result.
10. Automated test results.
11. Server typecheck result.
12. Client typecheck result.
13. Client build result.
14. Confirmation that scientific algorithms were NOT changed.
15. Confirmation that no mock/fake satellite data was introduced.

Do not declare completion based only on compilation or automated tests.

The actual browser workflow must be executed and verified.
</USER_REQUEST>
